border-width.$description: Stroke thickness. Tailwind v4 has NO --border-width-* theme namespace — border and ring widths are hardcoded in its utility definitions — so these generate no utilities and are consumed via arbitrary values, plain CSS, or a Figma variable binding. Numeric keys are factual (key = px).

1.$description: The default hairline: card edges, separators, input boundaries, table rules.

focus.$description: Focus-indicator thickness — the single source for the 23 `focus-visible:ring-2` sites. WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.13 asks for an area at least equivalent to a 2px perimeter of the control.
